intro: I'm Sanskar, a software developer. I started planning this website in April 2026 and opened its current repository in September 2026.

I work on programming languages, developer tools, video editing software and other open-source projects. My interests extend from systems programming in Rust and C++ to Android, web development, games and machine learning.
This site is my own place to document those projects, publish technical writing and share the things I learn while building software.

sections.heading: What I build
paragraphs: My work ranges from command-line tools to applications and games. I am particularly interested in the connection between the code underneath and the experience of using it.
The following areas give an overview of the projects and technologies I explore.

sections.heading: Open source
paragraphs: My public repositories contain the source code, development history and issue discussions. Each project has its own license and contribution process.

sections.heading: Technology interests
paragraphs: I use Rust, C and C++ for systems work; Kotlin and Java for Android; and JavaScript, TypeScript and React for the web. I also work with C#, .NET and Python.

sections.heading: Digital products
paragraphs: I publish digital products on Gumroad. The links below are also ways to support my work.

sections.heading: Developer community
paragraphs: My other profiles are listed below.

sections.heading: How I approach software
paragraphs: I prefer readable code, clear interfaces and practical tests. Accessibility, performance and security matter throughout development, not just before a release.

sections.heading: Always learning
paragraphs: I learn by building things, reading source code and revisiting earlier decisions when I find a better approach.

cta.heading: Let's talk
cta.paragraph: Have a project, a collaboration idea, or a question? Email is the best way to reach me.
